recommendedTextbook.title: Physical and Health Education for Junior Secondary Schools Book 1
recommendedTextbook.author: A. O. Folawiyo, B. A. Miller, S. M. Oloyede
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Meaning, Scope and Objectives of Physical and Health Education
subtopics: Definition of Physical Education and Health Education
Objectives: Physical fitness, motor skills, character development, emotional balance
Career opportunities: Sports coaching, physiotherapy, fitness training, sports journalism
objectives: Define Physical and Health Education accurately
State 5 specific developmental benefits of regular exercise
Identify 4 career paths available in sports and health sciences in Nigeria

topics.topic: Track Events: Sprints (100m, 200m) and Relay Races
subtopics: Sprint races (100m, 200m): Crouch start ('On your mark', 'Set', 'Go' / gun shot), arm drive, stride cadence, finish techniques
Relay races (4x100m, 4x400m): Baton grip and baton exchange techniques (visual vs non-visual exchange)
Rules and lane disqualifications in sprint races according to World Athletics rules
objectives: Demonstrate correct body posture during the 'Set' position in crouch start
Execute smooth non-visual baton exchange inside the 20-meter changeover box
List 3 common track infractions that lead to athlete disqualification

topics.topic: Field Events: Basic High Jump and Long Jump Techniques
subtopics: Long jump phases: Approach run, take-off, flight (sail / hitch-kick style), and landing in the sand pit
High jump techniques: Scissors jump and introduction to the Fosbury Flop
Safety equipment: Sand pit raking, foam landing mats, and takeoff board maintenance
objectives: Break down long jump into its 4 biomechanical phases
Demonstrate safe two-foot landing in the long jump pit to prevent knee injury
State the international rules governing valid take-off and foul jumps

topics.topic: Personal Cleanliness, Grooming and Environmental Sanitation
subtopics: Care of body organs: Skin, teeth, hair, eyes, ears, and fingernails
Clothing and footwear hygiene in tropical West African climates
School compound environmental sanitation and proper refuse disposal
objectives: Explain causes and prevention of dental caries and body odor
Outline daily personal hygiene routines for growing adolescents
Participate in a structured environmental sanitation clean-up drill
